subject: Request: expanded trial credits for long-context benchmarking
messages:
From: Kai Morrison <kai@hightrek.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Long-context eval — request for initial promo top-up

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising. We are lining up a two-week internal benchmark (model fusion + 200k token windows) and the default trial allowance won't cover the throughput and token volume we expect.

Quick summary of the POC:
- Workload: summarization + retrieval fusion with 150k–200k token contexts (we'll chunk & stitch).
- Expected throughput: 6–8 TPM sustained per worker, 10 concurrent workers at peak (~80 TPM).
- Duration: 2 weeks of active benchmarking + 1 week for integration tests.
- Rough token burn: ~2.2M tokens over the test window (conservative).

Request: could Redwood bump our initial self-serve credits to cover ~2M tokens (or equivalent $1,800 promotional credit) and add a 7–14 day trial extension so we can complete the run? I can share a short scope PDF attached.

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Kai Morrison
Head of ML — Hightrek AI
Attachments: hightrek_scope.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Morrison <kai@hightrek.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Long-context eval — request for initial promo top-up

Thanks Kai — good writeup and the scope PDF helps. I'll route this to our sales ops for a quick approval.

Proposed ask for internal review: increase self-serve promotion to $1,800 equivalent (approx 2M tokens at the rate we'll use for the POC) + 10-day extension on the trial window. We want to make sure we cover the heavy context use and not force them to throttle mid-benchmark.

Marissa — can you take the lead on approval/issuance? If you want me to request formal manager sign-off, I can loop Ben.

Kai — one more question for our provisioning: do you expect a lot of key rotation or shared test accounts? If so, note that in reply so we can set TTL and graph usage correctly.

- Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Strategist — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Long-context eval — request for initial promo top-up

Thanks Hannah — reviewed Kai's scope. Approve the promotional top-up as follows:

- Issuance: $1,800 promotional credit (token-equivalent)
- Additional trial extension: 10 days beyond their current trial end
- Notes: include an advisory that very large context windows may increase TPM and we should monitor throttling. If they hit sustained >100 TPM for more than 24 hours, CS should alert sales ops for a potential Dedicated conversation.

Marissa / Dev — please proceed with issuance and add the HubSpot deal note (Deal HT-2027-004). Attach a short credit note for their records.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Morrison <kai@hightrek.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Long-context eval — request for initial promo top-up

Hi Kai —

Thanks — we approved the promotional top-up. I've issued $1,800 of promotional credit to your account (token-equivalent) and extended the trial by 10 days. You should see the credit applied in the self-serve console within the hour.

Issuance details:
- Credit: $1,800 promotional (approx. 2,000,000 token-equivalent)
- Trial extension: +10 days (new expiry: 2027-06-22)
- File attached: issued_credit_note.pdf
- HubSpot: note saved to HT-2027-004 (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HT-2027-004)

Operational note: we set the default token TTL to 7 days and limited the initial API key scope to the benchmark project. If you need multiple keys or longer TTL, reply with the usernames and intended scopes and we'll adjust. Also: if you want a brief runbook on best practices for large context windows (prefetching, prefix KV caching, recommended batch sizes), Marissa and I can send a short doc.

Kai — confirm receipt and if the account owner needs a new API key created for team members, list the emails and we'll provision.

Best,
Dev Patel
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: issued_credit_note.pdf
